messages.subject: renderUI reactive for API calls
parts:
Is there any examples of a shiny app where multiple fields are used as input into a scripting logic that pulls data from an API rather than grabbing pre set data like (cars) 

I understand this is a pretty vague question and in truth it is very experimental so I am interested in seeing performance gains with shiny framework being self contained rather than a bunch of cron jobs using Rscript then shiny server  grabbing the data to then "do something with it"

at a very high level - UI has a bunch of input boxes >> you insert your required fields, then submit >> 
your fields are inserted into the server script where your API call for data grabs your specific table to then run your output on.

I guess what I am trying to say here is, is there a good example or a general guide for elegant coding of a project like this?
(statisticians write ugly code & I would rather not get caught up writing Spaghetti to achieve this :) 

cheers,
Narbeh
